`drift.test.ts` at the round's declared shift (`f2.driftSeedless ≥ 1`, rows 124 / 126); no test of the item is red.

family (NEAR #5 exit 1), replayed it on round S14's engine and REPORTED it as pre-existing, "not built in this round

already fails safely; this one does not.
